coverage: The verifier is executed as a separate Node process; tests assert real exit codes and absence of the success marker for failures.

Scenarios include missing preflight values, source/target equality, connection and migration query failures, unfinished and rolled-back migration history, mandatory aggregate count failures, empty/missing/malformed/mismatching manifests, and orphaned records.
The critical-path runner guard is exercised by its focused unit suite.
limits: The Prisma boundary is synthetic; no database restore, PostgreSQL connection, storage, email delivery, worker, or production service was exercised.
This retest does not close K03's separate live weekly restore acceptance.
